title: Toast with undo
brief: A dark confirmation toast with a mint check icon, a title, a short message and an Undo action that highlights on hover and focus.

inspiration.note: Took the layout of a status icon, a title with supporting line and an inline action; we used a dark rounded card instead of the left-border bar.
Took the idea of a short title and one action that sits in the same row; the colours and icon treatment are ours.
